name: dsh-steward
description: Steward for DeepSeek Harness: seven role charters injected at dispatch time (no user-selectable agent presets), a per-session Steward board in the right Sidebar (task DAG / list / ownership views, live subagents, run artifacts under tmp/steward, opened from the session header or automatically on the first dispatch), a Settings → Steward table for per-role model/effort, per-role routes from <project>/steward.config.json over the panel settings, the Agent Teams shared task board as the authoritative task source, and a /steward-roster command.
